# WWN rules register (#1101, Phase 0)

**Generated by `tools/wwn_register_audit.py` from `data/rules/wwn_register.json` — do not edit by hand.**

#1101 requires a rule-by-rule register before any code, with edition, printed section, rights, applicability, implementation, test, tabletop procedure, status, dependency and risk. This is that register. It is an audit, not a completion certificate.

## Sources and what may be used

| Source | Rights | Usable here | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Worlds Without Number System Reference Document (Kevin Crawford / Sine Nomine) | `cc0_srd_only` | yes | The CC0 dedication covers the System Reference Document. It is not a finding that the full commercial Worlds Without Number book is CC0, and it does not extend to the Deluxe material, art or protected setting text. |
| Worlds Without Number Free Edition PDF | `cc0_srd_only` | yes | Mirror of the free rules. Treated as the same grant as the SRD: it is not the Deluxe edition. |
| Worlds Without Number Deluxe (commercial PDF, user-supplied, not in this repository) | `commercial_blocked` | **no** | Not available to repository agents. Chapters G-K below stay blocked and unverified by rule of #1101: do not synthesize mechanics from chapter names, table-of-contents entries or recollection. |
| Cities Without Number System Reference Document | `cc0_srd_only` | yes | Primary character-scale game. Its published mechanics are immutable; WWN rows reuse it by delegation rather than reimplementing it. |
| Stars Without Number (Kevin Crawford / Sine Nomine) | `unverified` | **no** | The rights ledger (issue #200) records SWN as NOT VERIFIED and deliberately not promoted: no SWN SRD licence page has been read and recorded. Nothing may be imported while that entry stands. |
| Ashes Without Number (2025 commercial release) | `unverified` | **no** | No Ashes Without Number SRD was located. The CWN and WWN CC0 SRDs do not extend to it. Nothing may be imported while that entry stands. |

## What is actually done, and what only looks done

**implemented** (3)

- **C1 High Mage class, Arts, casting, preparation and Effort** (`WWN SRD p. 60; tracker chapter C`) — Delivered by #1044, which is closed. The tracker's instruction is to audit this before extending it, not to rewrite it.
- **C4 Spell corpus and learning procedure** (`WWN SRD p. 60; tracker chapter C`) — 83 spell identities: 52 high magic, 15 elementalist, 16 necromancer. Verified against the catalogue on 2026-11-03; the tracker's own count matches.
- **F1 Major Projects: renown, difficulty, opposition and completion** (`WWN SRD p. 322; tracker chapter F`) — Includes an explicit note on whether money purchase is modelled, so an omitted rule is visible rather than implied.

**verified_reuse** (1)

- **A1 Six attributes and their modifiers** (`WWN SRD p. 4; tracker chapter A`) — The tracker requires delegation to CWN, not a parallel attribute system. Attribute modifiers are pinned in tests/test_duplication_audit_1053.py as well, which asserts every layer agrees.

**partial** (4)

- **B1 Skill checks, saves, reactions and morale** (`WWN SRD p. 38; tracker chapter B`) — A resolver exists, but the equivalence audit the tracker asks for (WWN procedure against CWN, with published mapping tests) has not been written. Reactions and morale are not evidenced in this repository.
- **B2 Initiative, encumbrance, travel, healing, downtime and System Strain** (`WWN SRD p. 38; tracker chapter B`) — Initiative is implemented. Encumbrance, overland travel, healing and downtime procedures are not evidenced here.
- **B3 Combat action economy, Shock, armour, damage and hazards** (`WWN SRD p. 38; tracker chapter B`) — CWN combat exists. WWN Shock and its interaction with WWN armour have not been separately verified, and must not be folded into CWN combat.
- **C5 Spell effect resolution** (`WWN SRD p. 60; tracker chapter C`) — 13 of 83 effects are transcribed: the level-1 High Magic batch delivered by #1095. 70 remain and #1085 owns them. No rival resolver may be built.

**blocked** (5)

- **G1 Arts of the Gyre: options, variants, prerequisites and side effects** (`WWN Deluxe p. 344 (per tracker); source not available`) — Blocked until an authorized agent reads the purchased Deluxe copy. Do not invent mechanics from the chapter name.
- **H1 Heroic classes, heroic PC creation and progression** (`WWN Deluxe p. 356 (per tracker); source not available`) — Blocked. Must never become an automatic change to CWN character balance even when available.
- **I1 Legate eligibility, advancement, powers and limits** (`WWN Deluxe p. 358 (per tracker); source not available`) — Blocked. Opt-in late-campaign transformation only where authored and source-verified.
- **J1 Iterum creation, traversal, dwellers and special environments** (`WWN Deluxe p. 370 (per tracker); source not available`) — Blocked. Adaptation into NoöPunk interdimensional encounters needs separate setting tags, not an identity claim between WWN metaphysics and the NoöPunk Mythos.
- **K1 Additional Deluxe generators and encounter tools** (`WWN Deluxe p. 376 (per tracker); source not available`) — Blocked. Verify the Deluxe versus Free boundary before any redistribution.

## Cross-game compatibility (CWN ↔ WWN ↔ SWN ↔ AWN)

| Topic | CWN | WWN | SWN | AWN | Precedence | Citation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Combat, AC and saves | Immutable baseline. Armour class and saving throws as published in the CWN SRD. | Reuses the same resolution. WWN creature and equipment behaviour is supplemental and must be isolated. | Unverified source; no import permitted. | Unverified source; no import permitted. | **CWN wins any conflict.** | CWN Free Edition p. 218 onward, 'Mixing Sine Nomine Games Together' (tracker citation); WWN SRD p. 38. |
| Classes and advancement | PC progression, foci and skills are the baseline. | Warrior, Expert, Mage and Adventurer are optional WWN-native packages mapping onto CWN, never overwriting it. | Unverified. | Unverified. | **CWN character progression is never replaced; a WWN class is an alternative package, not a rewrite.** | Tracker chapter A; WWN SRD p. 4 onward. |
| Magic versus psychic Effort | No spellcasting; System Strain is the CWN resource and must not be changed. | Tradition Effort pools per mage class. | Psychic Effort and disciplines. | Unverified. | **Pools are separate by rule. Sharing one accidentally is a defect, not a design choice.** | Tracker chapter C, explicit instruction. |
| Skill vocabularies | The CWN skill list is authoritative for characters. | Backgrounds and skills map onto CWN rather than replacing it. | Unverified. | Unverified. | **CWN vocabulary wins; WWN backgrounds are a mapping layer.** | Tracker chapter A. |
| Items, tech levels and equipment | Cyberware, gear and tech levels as published. | Fantasy equipment is supplemental and must not silently retune CWN gear. | Unverified. | Unverified. | **CWN equipment rules win.** | Tracker chapters A and B. |
| Supernatural entities | No default supernatural layer. | Creatures of a Far Age, with stat blocks converted to CWN combat. | Unverified. | Unverified. | **WWN entities resolve with WWN statistics, presented through CWN combat; NoöPunk reskins fiction only.** | Tracker chapter E; WWN SRD p. 280. |
| Factions and projects | No faction turn engine. | Faction turns, assets and Major Projects. | Faction mechanics, unverified as an import. | Enclaves, crisis and site ledger (#1083). | **WWN and SWN faction mechanics complement one another; neither replaces the other. Ideology is a mod interface, not a stat.** | Tracker chapter F; WWN SRD p. 322. |
| Survival and stress | System Strain as published. | No separate survival stress layer. | Unverified. | Stress, crisis and enclaves (#1083). | **AWN owns survival stress; CWN System Strain is untouched by it.** | Tracker chapters B and H; #1083. |

## Phase 0 gaps, stated rather than smoothed over

- The compatibility matrix cites the tracker's own page references. It has not been re-verified against a copy of the CWN Free Edition PDF page 218 in this pass.
- The Deluxe chapters are blocked, so five of eleven chapters have no verifiable rows at all.
- No equivalence audit exists for the rows marked verified_reuse; 'reuse' is currently a design decision with a test that the delegated code works, not a published mapping test against WWN procedure text.

## What this register cannot tell you

It verifies that a claimed row names code and a test that exist. It cannot verify that the procedure is *faithful* to the printed book — that requires a human with the page open. A row marked `implemented` means "there is code with a test here", which is exactly what `docs/rules/CWN_IMMUTABLE_CORE_1068.md` warns is not the same claim as rules fidelity.
